about: Infernet house models: every provider node pulls and serves the models below that fit it, unless its operator opts out (infernet house-models off; uncensored only: infernet house-models uncensored off). Adding a model is a PR to apps/web/public/house-models.json in InfernetProtocol/infernet-protocol. digest = sha256 of the registry manifest (what `ollama list`/api/tags reports); size_bytes = all layers + config. Docs: https://infernetprotocol.com/docs/house-models
